name: Base P/T taken from "that creature" of the trigger — Belligerent Yearling, Eldrazi Mimic, Shape Stealer
notes: Found by tests/sweep.py. 'Whenever another Dinosaur you control enters, you may have this creature's base power become equal to that creature's power': the creature is picked after firing (setRefPerm), the effect lands on the ability's source. Yearling takes only power (6/2 from Colossal Dreadmaw's 6/6); Mimic and Shape Stealer take both.

scryfallData.name: Belligerent Yearling
scryfallData.oracle_text:
Trample
Whenever another Dinosaur you control enters, you may have this creature's base power become equal to that creature's power until end of turn.
scryfallData.flavor_text: One day it will be as terrifying as it thinks it is.

scryfallData.name: Eldrazi Mimic
scryfallData.oracle_text: Whenever another colorless creature you control enters, you may have this creature's base power and toughness become equal to that creature's power and toughness until end of turn.

scryfallData.name: Shape Stealer
scryfallData.oracle_text: Whenever this creature blocks or becomes blocked by a creature, this creature's base power and toughness become equal to that creature's power and toughness until end of turn.
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"Stand back. I know just what to do."
—Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker

scryfallData.name: Colossal Dreadmaw
scryfallData.oracle_text: Trample (This creature can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.)
scryfallData.flavor_text: If you feel the ground quake, run. If you hear its bellow, flee. If you see its teeth, it's too late.

scryfallData.name: Ornithopter
scryfallData.flavor_text:
"It has been my honor to improve on Thran's original design. Perhaps history will remember me in some small part for my work."
—Urza, in his apprenticeship
